tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Brand black. Text on paper and sand; the black hero, header and footer surfaces; growth in charts when selected.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Brand white. Page background; cards that sit on sand; text on ink.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Warm panel colour: alternating sections, chart surfaces, cards on paper.

tokens.name: sand-2
tokens.usage: Deeper sand: chips, placeholders, the 'Past' pill; lead text on ink (13.5:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline between rows and chart gridlines on paper and sand. Decorative only, never a control border.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Body copy on sand and in cards (12.9:1 on sand).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, axis labels on paper (6.9:1), sand (6.1:1) and sand-2 (5.6:1). The lightest grey allowed for small text on light grounds.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Non-text marks only on light grounds: baselines, input borders (3.6:1), disabled outlines. Fails 4.5:1 as small text on paper and sand.

tokens.name: ink-chart
tokens.usage: Growth bars and the second series on light grounds. Vanishes on ink (1.8:1): use chart-growth instead.

tokens.name: ink-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers on ink surfaces (header, footer, hero).

tokens.name: ink-raised
tokens.usage: Raised panels and bar tracks on ink.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Secondary text on ink (13.4:1); non-leading bars in ranking charts.

tokens.name: stone-2
tokens.usage: Muted labels on ink (9.2:1) and ink-raised (7.7:1).

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: The only accent. Primary button fill, red text on paper (5.5:1) and sand (5.0:1), decline in charts.

tokens.name: red-dark
tokens.usage: Red on ink: brand dot, eyebrows, decline (5.1:1 on ink). As small text it needs a ground at least as dark as #161514; on ink-raised it falls to 4.3:1. Also the focus ring on every ground.

tokens.name: red-tint
tokens.usage: Background of error messages and the 'Draft' pill, with red text (4.7:1).

tokens.name: event
tokens.usage: Placeholder for an event's own colour, set per event in the admin; used only on that event's pages. White text on it 6.2:1; check each new event colour against 4.5:1.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Light theme: paper. Dark theme (black sections: hero, header, footer): ink.

tokens.name: bg-panel
tokens.usage: Panels, cards and chart surfaces on bg. Dark value is #161514, not ink-raised, so red-dark text on it still passes (4.7:1).

tokens.name: bg-chip
tokens.usage: Chips, placeholders, unselected toggles.

tokens.name: bg-inverse
tokens.usage: Selected tabs, selected chips, the 'Published' pill, the secondary button fill.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Headings, figures and default text on bg and bg-panel.

tokens.name: fg-body
tokens.usage: Running text and leads on bg and bg-panel.

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, chart sub lines, axis labels on bg and bg-panel in both themes.

tokens.name: fg-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on bg-inverse.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows, gridlines, card dividers.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: 1px rule above a section, 2px rule above a key figure, outline button border.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Input, select and textarea borders (3.6:1 on paper, 5.6:1 on ink).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Red text and marks on bg: eyebrows, the brand dot, active underline, negative values, decline bars.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Error and draft backgrounds behind accent text (4.7:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill in both themes, with on-action text (5.5:1).

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text on action.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline at 3px offset: 3.9:1 on paper, 3.5:1 on sand, 5.1:1 on ink.

tokens.name: chart-growth
tokens.usage: Secondary series lines (dashed) in compare charts; 6.7:1 on ink in the dark theme.

tokens.name: chart-muted
tokens.usage: Context bars: every bar except the selected one and falls. Low contrast on purpose (1.5:1); each bar carries its value as text.

tokens.name: chart-baseline
tokens.usage: Dashed zero/100 line and averages in charts.

tokens.name: data-1
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 1, sapphire. Series colours are only for charts with several comparable series; fill or line, never text.

tokens.name: data-2
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 2, ochre.

tokens.name: data-3
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 3, teal. Scatter plots and small multiples stop here (3 series max).

tokens.name: data-4
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 4, plum. From slot 4 on, every series must be direct-labelled (dark-theme plum vs teal is close for colour-blind readers).

tokens.name: data-5
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 5, olive. A 6th series folds into Other in chart-muted.

tokens.name: seq-1
tokens.usage: Sequential (magnitude) ramp, lowest step: near zero. Heatmaps of one-directional values.

tokens.name: seq-2
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp, step 2.

tokens.name: seq-3
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp, step 3.

tokens.name: seq-4
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp, step 4.

tokens.name: seq-5
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp, highest step.

tokens.name: div-neg-2
tokens.usage: Diverging, strong fall (beyond −5%).

tokens.name: div-neg-1
tokens.usage: Diverging, mild fall.

tokens.name: div-mid
tokens.usage: Diverging midpoint: no change. Neutral sand, never a hue.

tokens.name: div-pos-1
tokens.usage: Diverging, mild growth.

tokens.name: div-pos-2
tokens.usage: Diverging, strong growth (beyond +5%).

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, menu items and chips on bg.

tokens.name: fg-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and controls only (exempt from 4.5:1); never for readable text.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs, drawers and the mobile menu.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page title, one per page, followed by the accent full stop. Scales 44px (phone) to 200px; leading .88–.9.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section titles. 28px on phones to 56px.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Chart headlines (a sentence with the finding) and card titles. 20–28px.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Key numbers in stat tiles. 34–56px, tabular figures.

styles.name: figure-sm
styles.usage: Numbers in market cards, details panels and market rows. Tabular figures.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark in the header. 16–22px.

styles.name: article-title
styles.usage: Article titles, 30–88px, max 18ch, ending in the full stop.

styles.name: event-city
styles.usage: City name on event cards and the event page, 40–56px, with the full stop.

styles.name: date-numeral
styles.usage: Day of the month on an event card's colour band.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: Pull quotes, 24–32px, closing with the red full stop.

styles.name: h2-article
styles.usage: Section headings inside an article.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Titles on article, report and event cards.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Research and commentary on how private wealth is created.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a page title. 17–21px, max 62ch.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Research and commentary on how private wealth is created.
styles.usage: Paragraphs. 15–18px.

styles.name: body-long
styles.sample: Cosmetics industry witnessed a moderate growth in the generation of billionaires.
styles.usage: Article body text, 16–18px, in fg-body, at measure-long.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Captions and chart sub lines, in fg-muted. 12–13px.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels above inputs.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase, in accent, above section titles. 11–12px, .14–.32em tracking.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Uppercase button labels.

styles.name: value-label
styles.usage: Numbers on charts. Tabular figures.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Wide-tracked uppercase labels for sidebars, footers and table heads (table heads .2em), in fg-muted or accent.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a value and its unit or caption.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, pills and tab cards.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside a card between title and text; field rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Grid gap between cards; page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding (18–28px); gap between a section header and its content.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop; gap between section blocks.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between columns of a two-column layout; section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width, centred.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Smallest tappable target: chips, icon buttons, menu links.

tokens.name: measure-long
tokens.usage: Maximum width of article body text.

tokens.name: measure-admin
tokens.usage: Maximum width of admin pages.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every interface element: buttons, cards, inputs, panels, tabs, pills.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Change badges in tabs and readouts: the only rounded interface element, because it holds a number.

tokens.name: radius-bar
tokens.usage: The free end of a chart bar and both ends of ranking bars.

tokens.name: radius-bar-base
tokens.usage: The baseline end of a chart bar.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Data dots and avatars.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Row dividers and gridlines in border.

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: Rule above a section, in border-strong.

tokens.name: stroke-key
tokens.usage: Rule above a key figure or chart principle, in border-strong.

tokens.name: stroke-tab
tokens.usage: Red underline on the selected tab.

tokens.name: stroke-chart
tokens.usage: Main line in trend and compare charts, smoothed.

tokens.name: stroke-spark
tokens.usage: Sparkline line.

tokens.name: stroke-icon
tokens.usage: Stroke width of the 24px line icons.

shadow.note: The interface is flat. Outlines are drawn as inset shadows so they never change a box's size.

tokens.name: shadow-outline
tokens.usage: Outline button, selected outline card.

tokens.name: shadow-hairline
tokens.usage: Count pills, white cards on paper, the details panel.

tokens.name: shadow-tab
tokens.usage: Red underline of the selected tab (use red-dark on ink).

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: The only real shadow: dialogs, dropdowns and toasts that float above the page.

tokens.name: aspect-cover
tokens.usage: Article cover images and typographic covers.

tokens.name: aspect-card
tokens.usage: Images on article, report and event cards.

tokens.name: aspect-portrait
tokens.usage: Speaker and author portraits (shown round).

tokens.name: aspect-hero
tokens.usage: Event page hero photos.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: Sticky header.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Mobile menu panel and dropdowns.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialog and its overlay.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, above everything.

tokens.name: opacity-area
tokens.usage: Top of the fading area fill under a trend line (fades to 0).

tokens.name: opacity-halo
tokens.usage: Halo ring around the latest or hovered point.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, colour and focus changes.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Menus, tabs, panels, toasts.

tokens.name: dur-data
tokens.usage: Data entering: lines drawing, bars growing, numbers counting up.

tokens.name: dur-morph
tokens.usage: Data changing: switching period, index or filter.

tokens.name: dur-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between neighbouring bars, cells or rows as they enter. Total stagger never above 400ms.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Everything entering or responding to the reader.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Data morphing from one state to another.
